mapper.insert: insert into note ( note_no, project_no, note_writer_no, note_title, note_content, note_ctime, note_utime ) values ( #{noteNo}, #{projectNo}, #{noteWriterNo}, #{noteTitle}, #{noteContent}, systimestamp, null )
mapper.select: select n.note_no as noteNo, n.project_no as projectNo, n.note_writer_no as noteWriterNo, e.emp_no as empNo, e.emp_name as empName, e.emp_dept_no as empDeptNo, e.emp_position_no as empPositionNo, n.note_title as noteTitle, n.note_content as noteContent, n.note_ctime as noteCtime, n.note_utime as noteUtime from note n inner join project_member pm on n.note_writer_no = pm.project_member_no inner join emp e on pm.emp_no = e.emp_no where n.note_no = #{noteNo}

select count(*) from note where project_no = #{projectNo}
and instr(note_title, #{req.keyword}) > 0
and dbms_lob.instr(note_content, #{req.keyword}) > 0
and ( instr(note_title, #{req.keyword}) > 0 or dbms_lob.instr(note_content, #{req.keyword}) > 0 )
mapper.update: update note set note_title = #{noteTitle}, note_content = #{noteContent}, note_utime = systimestamp where note_no = #{noteNo}
